notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content: [h2]Diceball Update 1.1.2[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We're pushing out a Patch today that addresses some issues and pain points we've been receiving feedback on since Update 1.1 and Update 1.1.1 (looking at you, Fungo Falls). You can check out the full changes below: [/p][list][*][p]The 'DFA'd' Achievement has been lowered to 50 Losses (was previously 100). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed 'One of Everything' Achievement[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players who have already unlocked all consumables may need to purchase an additional consumable at the Concession Stand on their next run to receive this Achievement.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fungo Falls 'Starter Card' has been changed to "Player 'Single' Have a 25% Chance to be 'Homerun'." We hope this fixes some of the pain points with using Fungo Falls, but keep the feedback rolling![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed the color of text on the in-game Clipboard for the Player when the Opponent has a card that affects Player dice roll outcomes (was previously Yellow, is now Red). [/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Diceball Update 1.1.1
notes.content: [h1]Diceball Update 1.1.1[/h1][p][/p][p]Checking back in with our players after Diceball Update 1.1, we received feedback that some cards were not working as intended (Endorsements,  Waste Pitch, Warning Track). In addition to these fixes, we've also been playing Diceball a LOT here at Ducknest Games and have found that the difficulty pendulum has swung very far in the opposite direction. [/p][p]Right now, we feel it is [i]far[/i] too easy to crush the opponent in most games. That being said, we've balanced the opponent teams in Games 2-10 to have [b]more[/b] cards and [b]better[/b] outcomes. We will continue to monitor difficulty and adjust as need be, but we hope these changes bring back a [i]little[/i] bit of the challenge to Diceball. Full changes can be found below: [/p][list][*][p]Game 2, Game 3, Game 4 opponents now have one card and have had a former 'Out' outcome replaced with a 'Double'.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Game 5, Game 6, Game 7 opponents now have two cards and have had two 'Out' outcomes replaced with 'Double' and 'Triple'.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Game 8, Game 9, Game 10 opponents now have three cards and have had former 'Out' outcomes replaced with a 'Double', 'Triple', and 'Homerun'.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing the old 'Barreled Up' card effect to still be present in certain scenarios. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Turned the lights off in the Locker Room on teams that are currently 'LOCKED'. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Diceball Update 1.1
notes.content: [h1]Diceball Update 1.1[/h1][p][/p][p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]First off we want to start by thanking everyone that purchased and supported Diceball over the last couple months. We've done a ton of reflecting on the feedback we gathered from our players during this period. Your feedback has been invaluable, and with this outpouring of information, we have made some massive changes to Diceball's card and consumable items, as well as implemented many other changes and fixes in this Update 1.1. [/p][p][/p][h2]Swing-and-a-Miss[/h2][p] [/p][p]Our most-received feedback items for Diceball were that 1) the teams after Rain Delay Bay were not unlocking properly and 2) that the game was far too difficult because a majority of the cards and consumables were either too expensive or downright bad. We know we missed the strike zone on this one and we apologize. We know how frustrating it was to be on the receiving end of a beatdown by the opponent. However, we're happy to share that in Update 1.1, we have fixed the team-unlocking issue and we have taken an aggressive approach to re-balancing all of the cards and consumables. [/p][p]In addition to our full-scale rebalancing efforts, we have made the decision to remove all non-original baseball outcomes, i.e. Single+, Double+, etc. We felt that a lot of these outcomes were not improving the overall gameplay loop and in fact made the game much more unnecessarily obtuse. All of these prior outcomes have been changed to an original outcome. We feel this will be a net positive change but apologize if there were any Single+ lovers out there. [/p][p]Please continue the outpouring of feedback via our channels and reach out with any bug issues or general feedback. Thank you all again for your continued support! This will be Diceball's last "major" update, as Ducknest Games will now shift focus to work full-time on Project #2. Follow us here and on our socials for development updates and we'll have lots to share when we're ready! Play Ball! [/p][p]You can view our full patch notes below: [/p][p][/p][h2]Update 1.1 Change Log[/h2][p][/p][olist][*][p]Updated almost all card and consumable effects and their corresponding card back art with appropriate re-balancing. [/p][/*][*][p] All consumables and cards have had their prices adjusted. [/p][list][*][p]Almost all items have been reduced in price to make them more accessible throughout a run. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Re-Balanced four of the original eight Starter cards and replaced them with more useful and unique options. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed non-original baseball outcomes. The outcomes that have been removed and replaced by original outcomes are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Single+[/p][/*][*][p]Double+ [/p][/*][*][p]Error & Two-Base Error[/p][/*][*][p]Infield Single[/p][/*][*][p]Sac Bunt[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Pitch[/p][/*][*][p]Foul Out[/p][/*][*][p]Hit-By-Pitch[/p][/*][*][p]Stolen Base[/p][/*][*][p]Caught Stealing[/p][/*][*][p]Pick-Off[/p][/*][*][p]Intentional Walk[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Glossary in the Binder has been updated to reflect removed terms. [/p][/*][*][p]With the removal of certain outcomes, specific Achievements became unobtainable. We've removed them and added the following achievements in their place: [/p][list][*][p]Elite Rotation - Own the Ace, Bullpen and Closer Cards Simultaneously in a Single Season[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced Analytics - Own the Good Jump, Hit And Run, and Weight Training Cards Simultaneously in a Single Season[/p][/*][*][p]Traffic On The Bases - Own the Leadoff, Ghostrunner, and Squeeze Play Cards Simultaneously in a Single Season.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Roll Button can now be activated with the 'Space Bar' key.[/p][/*][*][p]Fan reaction audio has been increased (those fans really wanted to cheer/boo!).[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the default volume of the Win/Loss audio when transitioning to the Post-Game screen (apologies to any eardrums that were blown out before this fix).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio bug related to run-scoring SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed persistent ball shadow issue when the Clipboard was opened during a Game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Confirmation Box to the Post-Game screen that will warn players attempting to return to the Main Menu that they will lose their progress if they do so. [/p][/*][*][p]Added support for MacOS devices. [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p]

notes.title: Diceball Update 1.02
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]We really appreciate the outpouring of support we've received since Diceball's launch! We've also received a lot of very insightful feedback into how you're all experiencing Diceball. The number one thing we've heard from our players is that Diceball can be a little *too* unforgiving and difficult because of dice roll RNG. That's not something we want! Today we're pushing out an update that is hopefully a good first step to making Diceball a more balanced and enjoyable experience.[/p][p]We're starting this journey by changing some default dice roll outcomes for each team. Each team in the Locker Room has had *two* of their default dice outcomes changed from an Out-based outcome to an outcome that puts a runner on base. We recognize this might not be a drastic change, but in our testing we found this at least moves the needle a little more in the favor of the player during games. We will continue to monitor feedback and work on building new ways to get the most out of your team during their Championship Run. You can find the full patch notes and changes below: [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Diceball Update 1.02[/u][/h3][p][/p][p]- The Rain Delay Bay Rookies have had outcomes 1-6 and 2-4 changed to 'Walk' and 'Single', respectively. [/p][p]- The Homeron Hitters have had their 1-2 and 2-4 outcomes changed to 'Walk' and 'Walk'. [/p][p]- The Fungo Falls Fireballs have had outcomes 1-3 and 2-4 changed to 'Single' and 'Single'. [/p][p]- The Cycle City Sluggers have had their 1-5 and 4-4 outcomes changed to 'Double' and 'Triple', respectively. [/p][p]- The Velocity Valley Vultures have had their 3-3 and 3-4 outcomes changed to 'Single' and 'Walk', respectively. [/p][p]- The Rundown Ridge Round-Trippers have had outcomes 1-4 and 3-4 changed to 'Walk' and 'Single', respectively. [/p][p]- The Bleacher Beach Creatures have had their 1-2 and 2-5 outcomes changed to 'Single' and 'Walk', respectively. [/p][p]- The Batflip Bluffs Battery have had outcomes 1-1 and 4-6 changed to 'Walk' and 'Single', respectively. [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Additional Patch Notes:[/u] [/h3][p][/p][p]- Some Teams in the Locker Room were not having their default dice outcomes correctly displayed in the 'Dice Rolls' window. This has been fixed and updated to show the correct rolls for each team. [/p][p]- Card descriptions for 'Sinker' and 'Bullpen' were incorrect. These have been updated to show the correct description for the associated card's effect.[/p][p]- Various audio tweaks. [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Diceball Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you to everyone that has purchased and played Diceball! We sincerely appreciate all the support and feedback we've received following Diceball's release. In Update 1.01, the following has been fixed or updated to work correctly: 

- Some card art was not properly updated and has now been correctly added. 
- Diceball was defaulting to the user's native resolution by default. This has been changed to default to a supported resolution in the event that the user is playing on a machine that has an abstract native resolution. 
- Some teams were not properly unlocking (looking at you, Homeron) after a Championship Run. This has been resolved and all teams should unlock correctly moving forward. 
- Some achievements were not activating correctly. These should be fixed now, but will not update retroactively. 
- Some cards were not working as intended after their purchase. 
- Some cards were having their effects carry over into a new run, causing an unfair advantage for the player or opponent. 
- The pennant screen was not properly updating the player's total Championship wins with their respective team. 

Apologies for some of this stuff not working right out the gate, but we are committed to improving and updating Diceball where we find it falls short. Please reach out to us with any feedback! 

Thanks, 

Diceball Dev Team
